official_example.operative_text: Xirat’p’s Sorcerous Barrages (Psychic): At the end of your  Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6"  of this model: on a 2-3, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on  a 4-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit  suffers D6 mortal wounds.
